verdict.rationale: Retell documents custom functions that call your API mid-call, with configurable URL, method, headers, parameters and responses. Function calling can call external APIs, and agents can call remote MCP server tools during a live call. Nothing in the evidence covers how the agent avoids dead air while a tool runs, so that part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented filler speech or latency handling during tool execution, evidence of how tool results are spoken back, and independent hands-on corroboration of smooth mid-call tool use.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can call external APIs and custom functions mid-conversation and speak the result without awkward dead air

citations.quote: Add a custom function to a Retell single- or multi-prompt agent to call your API mid-call. Configure URL, method, headers, parameters, and responses.
Function calling lets Retell single or multi-prompt agents take real actions — transfer calls, end calls, book appointments, send SMS, and call external APIs.
Connect your single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and the agent can call that server's tools during a live call.
